title: PR #133: docs(catalog): add missing platform and function contracts
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: False

## Summary

Adds a distinct catalog component and residual function contracts for missing cross-platform deployment and ecosystem capabilities.

### Additions
- `COMP-PLATFORM-DISTRIBUTION` and `FN-PLAT-DIST-001..007`
- GlobusOS native desktop/host-edition/capability functions
- Node lifecycle, RPC error semantics, and blocked finality query
- SDK cross-language transaction vectors and provider compatibility
- Aurora policy/capability tool invocation and approval-gated wallet actions
- Canonical transaction validation, explicit consensus/finality decision tracking, and blocked VM bytecode decode contract

### Boundaries
- Catalog/control-plane only; no duplicate implementations or SSOT ownership transfer.
- New records are `RESIDUAL` or `BLOCKED`, with `UNBOUND_RESIDUAL` source bindings where source mapping is not yet proven.
- Unknown consensus/finality and ATCB-vs-ATC1 remain blocked.
- Bidirectional source reconciliation, exact-SHA test evidence, and normative contracts remain required. This PR makes no completeness or production-readiness claim.
- Keep Draft; no auto-merge and no gate weakening.

Related: [catalog reconciliation #115](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/a-townchain-ecosystem/pull/115), [catalog implementation program #132](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/a-townchain-ecosystem/issues/132), [cross-chain proposal #127](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/a-townchain-ecosystem/pull/127), [crypto-service proposal #129](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/a-townchain-ecosystem/pull/129), [Globus/Aurora proposal #130](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/a-townchain-ecosystem/pull/130).

No implementation or verification status is inferred from these catalog records.

### Ecosystem architecture baseline

Added [ATC-ECOSYSTEM-REFERENCE-ARCHITECTURE-001.md](docs/architecture/ATC-ECOSYSTEM-REFERENCE-ARCHITECTURE-001.md), covering canonical SSOT ownership, deployment profiles, security/cryptographic boundaries, chain/VM and cross-chain constraints, API contracts, Aurora controls, developer workflows, and exact-SHA acceptance gates. This is architecture/control-plane metadata only; unresolved decisions remain open and release remains BLOCKED.
